description: Opt-in, bounded, evidence-recorded live local-model admission gate. Dry-run remains the default; live admission requires both mode=OPT_IN_LIVE and opt_in_live=True. The gate composes the metadata-only LocalModelAdmissionPolicy (rung 8) with the router and inventory. Even a READY decision keeps source_mutation_authorized=False, corpus_write_authorized=False, and training_eligible=False — those gates are independent. No I/O: the gate never calls a model, never spawns a subprocess, never reaches the network.
purpose: First rung of the live-local-model campaign. Defeats the BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL reason in the corpus eligibility guard for opt-in callers, while keeping every other safety default closed. Sets up LIVE_MODEL_MOCK_COMPATIBILITY_HARNESS_LOCK_001 to exercise the live-model interface against fixture providers.
invariants: LiveModelAdmissionGate.evaluate is a pure function — no I/O.
Default config mode=DRY_RUN, opt_in_live=False, allow_network_provider=False, require_pinned_id=True.
Dry-run default blocks live admission with LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_BLOCKED_DRY_RUN_DEFAULT.
Explicit opt-in with a pinned, available, current id on a local provider for an allowed task class produces LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_READY with live_call_authorized=True.
Unpinned model_id (not in CURRENT_MODEL_IDS) blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_BLOCKED_UNPINNED_MODEL.
Network provider blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_BLOCKED_NETWORK_PROVIDER under default config.
Inventory present but model not in it blocks with LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_BLOCKED_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.
Base policy refusal yields LOCAL_MODEL_LIVE_ADMISSION_METADATA_ONLY (e.g. missing capabilities) — live not authorized.
EVERY decision (READY included) sets source_mutation_authorized=False, corpus_write_authorized=False, training_eligible=False.
scripts/models/live_model_admission*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
